# navigation-bank

Synthetic test bank of one fictional person: home and dacha chores, work projects and HR, a Lisbon trip, recipes and health to-dos. Russian and English notes mixed; one image without text.

## Folders

- `health/` — Health to-do list in Russian: doctor visits and tests still to arrange
- `home/` — Household notes grouped by topic; see subfolders
- `home/appliances/` — Notes on home appliances, e.g. the wall boiler service manual transcript
- `home/car/` — Car service history and booked services
- `home/dacha/` — Dacha (country house) notes in Russian: compact tractor, season closing checklist
- `home/garden/` — Garden wildlife notes in Russian, e.g. feeding the hedgehog
- `recipes/` — Home recipes in Russian: soups and blini
- `travel/` — Trip plans; one subfolder per trip
- `travel/lisbon-2026/` — Lisbon trip, November 2026: itinerary, hotel confirmation, packing list
- `work/` — Work notes grouped by kind; see subfolders
- `work/finance/` — Approved project budgets for 2026
- `work/hr/` — Time-off policy summary, PTO balance and booked days off
- `work/projects/` — Work projects, one subfolder per codename
- `work/projects/heron/` — Project Heron: overview and status
- `work/projects/kestrel/` — Project Kestrel: overview and standups
- `work/retro/` — Team retrospectives: notes and whiteboard photos
